features_under_test: all-features (field, package, opc, docx, epub, entropyfs-store, deflate-replay, ...)

controls.intra: empty cache, one fresh-process observation per member (intra-observation reuse floor)
controls.warm: explain --analyze in-order per family (shared store, cache on)
controls.warm_fresh: fresh OS process, cache intact (counter liveness)
controls.postclear_star: fresh OS process after the store's cache/ directory is removed, on the max-warm-reuse member (durability falsifier)

notes: All commands ran through compose.yaml inside the pinned, capped doc-baseline image; nothing ran on the host except git and docker. N3 had no SQLite comparison; its only baseline was borg CDC, so none is reproduced. No compression claim: a shared blob is scored as state/work.
